_note: YOUR PROJECTS. Each block between { } is one project; the order here is the order on the site. To add a project: copy a whole block (from { to }), paste it after the last one, put a comma between the blocks, and give it a new unique id. Images for a project go in images.json under the same id.

_fields.id: Unique name without spaces, used in the link (#/work/your-id) and to match images in images.json
_fields.title: Project name
_fields.type: Kind of project, e.g. Branding, UX / UI, Motion, Web design
_fields.course: The course / module it was made for
_fields.summary: One sentence, shown in the Work slider
_fields.overview: Overview tab. One text, or a list of paragraphs: ["First.", "Second."]
_fields.link: Optional link to a live version. Leave "" to hide the button
_fields.hidden: true = not shown on the site (handy for drafts)
